title: The Living Plant — autonomous major game build
goal: Evolve I.C.E. substantially toward the approved coastal-jungle industrial pixel-art reference. The player says the current game barely changed: four repeated horizontal floors, tiny characters, flat rectangular machinery and an oversized operator dialogue. Rebuild the hub and at least one job site as distinct authored industrial locations with intermediate platforms, functional stairs, railings, shaped furnace/stack/pipework, substantial original pixel art, environmental depth and readable animated PPE people. Make the flame-first industrial adventure attractive to watch and play. Give the studio creative authority over layouts, scene coordinates, artwork, animation, UI and coordinated implementation; this is a major playable build, not preservation of the existing composition. A closed combustion chamber should glow through ports, with causally appropriate smoke and operator reactions. Use the actual target image as art direction and the player screenshot as evidence of what is inadequate. Improve the operator interaction so it conveys useful information with much less obstruction. Coordinate related changes across the entire product, integrate them, correct failures and publish a verified preview through this single production job.
acceptance: The hub and at least one contract site have meaningfully different authored geography from the baseline. They include intermediate platforms and at least one functional walking staircase with actual collision support; not just repainted rails or fake stairs.

The playable foreground, equipment silhouettes, material texture, jungle/coast depth and character readability show a substantial visible step toward the reference at normal phone scale. A backdrop by itself is insufficient.

Physical movement, touch ergonomics, fullscreen, manual equipment, flame observation, cause/effect diagnosis, repair/adjust/verify/hold, rewards and save/reload remain working player behaviors. Implementation and internal coordinates may change to achieve the brief.
Operator dialogue is compact and useful, with less obstruction of the game and accessible choices. Instructions and current UI may be redesigned together.

The three current contracts remain playable with the provided tools. The authoritative combustion behavior and independent world/flame/audio timing remain causal. Upgrade purchases are not required to finish these contracts.

Deliver a complete integrated game build. The automated verifier must execute the real touch routes and physical staircase check; independent visual QA must inspect actual candidate screenshots against the approved reference before automatic preview publication.
